company.name: Komodor
company.shortDescription: Komodor tracks changes and alerts across the Kubernetes stack and analyzes their effect.
company.description: Komodor is a Dev-First Kubernetes operations platform focused on automating Kubernetes operations. The platform ingests Kubernetes events each day and then bakes the key learnings directly into the system. Komodor enables developers to gain a clear understanding of all events and dependencies inside a cluster. Every deployment, configuration, and code change can be tracked and correlated with the status of nodes, pods, endpoints, and other K8s infrastructure elements.
